profile.headline: Software Developer at ASRC Federal
profile.summary:
Although transitioning to a new industry, I bring easily translatable experience working as a part of a team and elevating those around me. I genuinely enjoy the puzzle-solving aspect of programming, and have found the greatest joy in the problems requiring the most creative solutions.

I have the most experience working in Java, JS, and HTML, but I welcome challenges no matter the skills needed.

positions.title: Logistics Analyst
positions.description: Developed and maintained Excel workbooks and Tableau dashboards for reporting on performance metrics; provided support for the negotiation and administration of carrier rates; and unofficially (but with company support) organized sports teams, holiday activities, and other creative outlets for coworkers.

positions.title: Transportation Analyst (Lean TMS Admin)
positions.description: Administration of Lean TMS including assisting with network optimizations, rate maintenance, and batch payments; developed and routinely ran reporting for analysis of cost comparisons, utilization opportunities, and performance metrics; and developed and maintained carrier scorecards.

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description: Filed for and obtained 501c3 status; member of a small team that planned, publicized, and ran a number of fundraisers.

volunteerExperiences.description: Coached for 20 seasons over 12 years in a recreational soccer league for U18 boys. Made a number of life-long connections with players while providing mentorship that emphasized lessons applicable to both soccer and life.

After organizing weekly pickup games for months, collaborated with a few others to build the pickup games into a five team league for young men under 30. After six seasons, we had grown the league to 12 men's teams, six women's teams, and a waiting list of other teams looking to join.
Assisted with finances and referee assignments; my focus was on player recruitment, registration, and management.
